additional_info.subject: RE: 0380517 - ID0380517-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / PN 312571675/02] Charger connector status changes after automatic reboot. CRM:02023000159
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I must admit I don’t quite understand your response.
You are asking me if the problem is still ongoing; however, that is not the subject of my request.
A connector was unlocked following an automatic reboot, and I would like to know the reason for this.
When we block connectors, it can be for safety reasons for our clients. We cannot afford to have connectors that unlock on their own.
The connector has not been able to unlock itself since, but I am trying to understand why it unlocked the first time to prevent this from happening again.
Thank you in advance for your response.
Best regards,
Maxime MAUCLER

additional_info.body:
Hi Maxime,
I hope this email finds you well.
Apologies for not identifying the root cause earlier. Upon analyzing the logs, it was discovered that the configuration was altered to "Operative," as indicated in the logs provided. This issue is not software-related, as the outlet remains unchanged unless manually adjusted. Additionally, I made an attempt to reboot the charger this morning did not reveal any instances where outlet 2 was available. Efforts are being made to ascertain who made the manual adjustment. Presently, outlet 2 is configured as "Inoperative."
